entities.name: Havenwood
entities.description: A tremendous forest south of the Sarpadian Mountains on Sarpadia, home of the Elven Empire.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria whose northern coast Havenwood reached.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Havenwood lies.

entities.name: Elven Empire
entities.description: The vast empire of the elves of Havenwood, crushed by the thallids.

entities.name: Tev Loneglade
entities.description: A planeswalker who made his abode in Havenwood.

entities.name: Thelon
entities.description: A powerful elven druid who created the thallids.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Sentient fungus creatures created by Thelon that produced saprolings and destroyed the Elven Empire.

entities.name: Eub Hlut
entities.description: A tiny people who long after the fall of Sarpadia inhabited the Foulmere.

events.summary: Thelon learns to create thallid creatures out of fungus, which produce saprolings used as food when crops wither.
events.quote: learned to create creatures out of fungus called thallids which produced saprolings

events.summary: The thallids grow sentient and, vastly outnumbering the elves, crush the Elven Empire in a single day.
events.quote: crushed the Elven Empire in a single day

relations.note: Thelon learned to make thallids from fungus.
relations.quote: learned to create creatures out of fungus called thallids which produced saprolings

relations.note: The thallids destroyed the Elven Empire.
relations.quote: crushed the Elven Empire in a single day

relations.note: Havenwood reached the northern coast of Sarpadia.
relations.quote: reaching the northern coast of Sarpadia
